premise: Pinecone thinks she's plain next to Flower's petals and Caterpillar's dots, nothing to give — until the sun opens her scales and a gust sends her little winged seeds spinning away over the meadow.
inspiration: Andersen's The Fir Tree, turned: the plain one doesn't wait for glory — her gift is already inside her, and it flies off to become a forest.
lesson: Everyone carries something wonderful, even when it doesn't show.
learning: Pine seeds have little wings and spin away on the wind.

en-US.title: Pinecone's Secret Seeds
en-US.text: In the meadow, {flower:enter} Flower opened her eight yellow petals, and {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to flower} Caterpillar crawled up to admire them. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:pulse} "So pretty!" Beside them sat {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to flower} Pinecone, brown and quiet. {pinecone:face sad} [sighs] {pinecone:live talk} "Flower has petals," she said. "Caterpillar has dots. I only have scales." {flower:live talk} [gently] "Just wait for the sun," said Flower. {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Out came the sun, warm and bright. {pinecone:shake 0.3} Pinecone felt her scales loosen… {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} and she opened them wide, like a flower. {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] "Oh!" {canvas:wind 0.7} {sfx:gust} {all:wobble} Then — whoosh! — along came a gust of wind. {pinecone:sparkle} Out from her scales flew tiny seeds, each with one little wing. Spin, spin, spin, away over the meadow! {canvas:wind stop} {caterpillar:live look-up} Caterpillar reared up tall to watch them go. [curious] "What were those?" {flower:face happy} {flower:glow} [happily] "Pine trees," said Flower, "that haven't grown yet." {pinecone:glow} Pinecone didn't only have scales. She was full of trees.

es-ES.title: Las semillas secretas de Piña
es-ES.text: En el prado, {flower:enter} Flor abrió sus ocho pétalos amarillos, y {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to flower} Oruga se acercó despacito a admirarlos. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:pulse} —¡Qué bonitos! A su lado estaba {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to flower} Piña, marrón y callada. {pinecone:face sad} [sighs] {pinecone:live talk} —Flor tiene pétalos —dijo—. Oruga tiene lunares. Y yo, solo escamas. {flower:live talk} [gently] —Tú espera a que salga el sol —dijo Flor. {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Y salió el sol, calentito y brillante. {pinecone:shake 0.3} Piña notó que se le aflojaban las escamas… {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} y las abrió de par en par, como una flor. {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Oh! {canvas:wind 0.7} {sfx:gust} {all:wobble} Entonces… ¡fiuuu!, llegó una ráfaga de viento. {pinecone:sparkle} De entre sus escamas salieron volando semillitas, cada una con su alita. ¡Y venga a dar vueltas, lejos, por encima del prado! {canvas:wind stop} {caterpillar:live look-up} Oruga se estiró bien alta para verlas marchar. [curious] —¿Qué eran? {flower:face happy} {flower:glow} [happily] —Pinos —dijo Flor—, que todavía tienen que crecer. {pinecone:glow} Piña no tenía solo escamas. Estaba llena de árboles.

ja-JP.title: まつぼっくりの ひみつ
ja-JP.text: のはらで、{flower:enter}お花が、きいろい八まいのはなびらをひらきました。{caterpillar:enter}{caterpillar:go to flower}あおむしさんが、もぞもぞ見にきて、{caterpillar:face happy}{caterpillar:pulse}「きれい！」 そのとなりには、{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to flower}ちゃいろくて、しずかなまつぼっくり。{pinecone:face sad}[sighs]{pinecone:live talk}「お花には、はなびら。あおむしさんには、てんてん。わたしには、かさだけ」 {flower:live talk}[gently]「お日さまを、まっててごらん」 とお花。{canvas:sunshine 0.8}ぽかぽかのお日さまが、でてきました。{pinecone:shake 0.3}まつぼっくりのかさが、ゆるんで…{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live open hold}{sfx:crackle}お花みたいに、ぱあっとひらきました。{caterpillar:face surprised}[gasps]「わあ！」 {canvas:wind 0.7}{sfx:gust}{all:wobble}そこへ、ひゅうっ！かぜがふいてきました。{pinecone:sparkle}かさのあいだから、小さなたねがとびだします。どれにも、小さなはねがひとつ。くるくるくるっと、のはらのむこうへ！{canvas:wind stop}{caterpillar:live look-up}あおむしさんは、せのびして見おくりました。[curious]「いまの、なあに？」 {flower:face happy}{flower:glow}[happily]「まだ大きくなっていない、まつの木よ」 とお花。{pinecone:glow}まつぼっくりにあるのは、かさだけじゃありません。木が、いっぱいつまっていたのです。

de-DE.title: Was im Tannenzapfen steckt
de-DE.text: Auf der Wiese öffnete {flower:enter} die Blume ihre acht gelben Blütenblätter, und {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to flower} die Raupe kroch heran, um sie zu bewundern. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:pulse} „Wie schön!“ Daneben saß {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to flower} der Tannenzapfen, braun und still. {pinecone:face sad} [sighs] {pinecone:live talk} „Die Blume hat Blütenblätter“, sagte er. „Die Raupe hat Punkte. Und ich? Ich habe nur Schuppen.“ {flower:live talk} [gently] „Warte nur, bis die Sonne kommt“, sagte die Blume. {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Da kam die Sonne, warm und hell. {pinecone:shake 0.3} Der Tannenzapfen spürte, wie seine Schuppen locker wurden… {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} und er öffnete sie weit, wie eine Blume. {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] „Oh!“ {canvas:wind 0.7} {sfx:gust} {all:wobble} Da – huiii! – kam ein Windstoß. {pinecone:sparkle} Aus seinen Schuppen flogen winzige Samen, jeder mit einem kleinen Flügel. Sie drehten sich wie kleine Propeller, rundherum, rundherum, weit über die Wiese davon! {canvas:wind stop} {caterpillar:live look-up} Die Raupe reckte sich ganz hoch, um ihnen nachzuschauen. [curious] „Was war denn das?“ {flower:face happy} {flower:glow} [happily] „Tannenbäume“, sagte die Blume, „die noch nicht gewachsen sind.“ {pinecone:glow} Der Tannenzapfen hatte nicht nur Schuppen. Er war voller Bäume.

fr-FR.title: Le secret de Pomme de pin
fr-FR.text: Dans le pré, {flower:enter} Fleur a ouvert ses huit pétales jaunes, et {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to flower} Chenille s’est approchée pour les admirer. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:pulse} « Qu’ils sont beaux ! » À côté d’elles, il y avait {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to flower} Pomme de pin, brune et silencieuse. {pinecone:face sad} [sighs] {pinecone:live talk} « Fleur a des pétales, a-t-elle dit. Chenille a de jolis points. Et moi, je n’ai que des écailles. » {flower:live talk} [gently] « Attends donc le soleil », a dit Fleur. {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Le soleil est sorti, tout chaud, tout brillant. {pinecone:shake 0.3} Pomme de pin a senti ses écailles se desserrer… {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} et elle les a ouvertes en grand, comme une fleur. {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] « Oh ! » {canvas:wind 0.7} {sfx:gust} {all:wobble} Et puis — fouuu ! — un coup de vent est arrivé. {pinecone:sparkle} De ses écailles se sont envolées des graines minuscules, chacune avec sa petite aile. Et ça tournait, tournait, tournait, loin au-dessus du pré ! {canvas:wind stop} {caterpillar:live look-up} Chenille s’est dressée bien haut pour les regarder partir. [curious] « C’était quoi ? » {flower:face happy} {flower:glow} [happily] « Des pins, a dit Fleur, qui n’ont pas encore poussé. » {pinecone:glow} Pomme de pin n’avait pas que des écailles. Elle était pleine d’arbres.

it-IT.title: I semi segreti di Pigna
it-IT.text: Nel prato, {flower:enter} Fiore ha aperto i suoi otto petali gialli, e {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to flower} Bruco si è avvicinato per ammirarli. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:pulse} «Che belli!» Lì accanto c'era {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to flower} Pigna, marrone e silenziosa. {pinecone:face sad} [sighs] {pinecone:live talk} «Fiore ha i petali», ha detto. «Bruco ha i puntini. Io ho solo squame.» {flower:live talk} [gently] «Aspetta il sole, e vedrai», ha detto Fiore. {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Ed ecco il sole, caldo e luminoso. {pinecone:shake 0.3} Pigna ha sentito le squame allentarsi… {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} e le ha aperte tutte, come un fiore. {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] «Oh!» {canvas:wind 0.7} {sfx:gust} {all:wobble} Poi — FIUUU! — è arrivata una folata di vento. {pinecone:sparkle} Dalle sue squame sono volati via tanti semini, ognuno con una piccola ala. Gira, gira, gira, via sopra il prato! {canvas:wind stop} {caterpillar:live look-up} Bruco si è alzato bello dritto per guardarli andare. [curious] «Cos'erano?» {flower:face happy} {flower:glow} [happily] «Pini», ha detto Fiore, «che non sono ancora cresciuti.» {pinecone:glow} Pigna non aveva solo squame. Era piena di alberi.

zh-TW.title: 松果的祕密種子
zh-TW.text: 草地上，{flower:enter}小花張開她八片黃黃的花瓣，{caterpillar:enter}{caterpillar:go to flower}毛毛蟲爬過來欣賞。{caterpillar:face happy}{caterpillar:pulse}「好漂亮！」 旁邊坐著{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to flower}松果，咖啡色的，安安靜靜的。{pinecone:face sad}[sighs]{pinecone:live talk}「小花有花瓣，」 她說，「毛毛蟲有點點。我只有鱗片。」 {flower:live talk}[gently]「等太陽出來吧。」 小花說。{canvas:sunshine 0.8}太陽出來了，暖暖的，亮亮的。{pinecone:shake 0.3}松果覺得鱗片慢慢鬆開了……{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live open hold}{sfx:crackle}她把鱗片張得大大的，像一朵花。{caterpillar:face surprised}[gasps]「哇！」 {canvas:wind 0.7}{sfx:gust}{all:wobble}這時——呼！吹來一陣風。{pinecone:sparkle}好多小種子從鱗片裡飛出來，每一顆都有一片小翅膀。轉呀轉，轉呀轉，飛過草地，飛得好遠好遠！{canvas:wind stop}{caterpillar:live look-up}毛毛蟲抬高身子，看著它們飛走。[curious]「那些是什麼？」 {flower:face happy}{flower:glow}[happily]「是松樹，」 小花說，「還沒長大的松樹。」 {pinecone:glow}原來，松果不是只有鱗片。她的身體裡，藏著滿滿的樹呢。

zh-HK.title: 松果的秘密種子
zh-HK.text: 草地上，{flower:enter}小花張開了八片黃色的花瓣，{caterpillar:enter}{caterpillar:go to flower}毛毛蟲爬過來，看得入了迷。{caterpillar:face happy}{caterpillar:pulse}「好靚呀！」 旁邊坐着{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to flower}松果，一身啡色，安安靜靜。{pinecone:face sad}[sighs]{pinecone:live talk}「小花有花瓣，」 她說，「毛毛蟲有點點。我就淨係得鱗片。」 {flower:live talk}[gently]「等太陽伯伯出嚟啦。」 小花說。{canvas:sunshine 0.8}太陽出來了，又暖又亮。{pinecone:shake 0.3}松果覺得鱗片慢慢鬆開……{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live open hold}{sfx:crackle}她把鱗片張得大大的，好像一朵花。{caterpillar:face surprised}[gasps]「嘩！」 {canvas:wind 0.7}{sfx:gust}{all:wobble}這時——呼！吹來一陣風。{pinecone:sparkle}一粒粒小種子從鱗片裏飛出來，每粒都有一片小翅膀。轉呀轉，轉呀轉，飛過草地，飛到很遠很遠！{canvas:wind stop}{caterpillar:live look-up}毛毛蟲挺起身子，看着種子飛走。[curious]「嗰啲係乜嘢嚟㗎？」 {flower:face happy}{flower:glow}[happily]「係松樹，」 小花說，「仲未長大嘅松樹。」 {pinecone:glow}原來松果不只有鱗片。她身體裏，裝滿了一棵一棵的樹呢！

crackle.prompt: a dry pinecone's scales creaking open with tiny soft crackles, very close, realistic
